title: Is this task still consistent with what it claimed?
intro: check is read-only and answers three questions at once: does the record still describe this checkout, is the work inside the claimed scope, and is anything blocking acceptance.

scenarios.title: Work inside the claimed scope
scenarios.explain: Every finding is printed, not only the failures, so the report says what was checked rather than only what went wrong.

scenarios.title: A file changed that the task never claimed
scenarios.explain: check names the individual file, because the useful question is which change to move or claim — not merely that something is wrong.
